description: Unit tests for the DER parser in the net::der namespace, testing various parsing scenarios including TLV reading, optional tags, tag parsing, and error conditions.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing DER-encoded data, supporting reading tags, values, sequences, optional tags, and bit strings.

classes.name: BitString
classes.description: A class representing a DER Bit String, including unused bits and byte data.

methods.name: ReadTagAndValue
methods.description: Reads a tag and its associated value from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadRawTLV
methods.description: Reads a raw TLV (Tag-Length-Value) from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadSequence
methods.description: Reads a sequence of DER-encoded data.

methods.name: ReadUint64
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 64-bit integer from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag
methods.description: Reads an optional tag, indicating whether it is present.

methods.name: SkipOptionalTag
methods.description: Skips an optional tag if present.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads a specific tag from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadConstructed
methods.description: Reads a constructed tag, verifying its type.

methods.name: HasMore
methods.description: Checks if there is more data to parse.

methods.name: ReadBitString
methods.description: Reads a DER Bit String from the input stream.
